title: Hailee Steinfeld on How Motherhood Is Shaping Her Movie Choices
excerpt:
The Hawkeye star is bringing a new perspective to her career decisions.
Her upcoming projects include Hexed and Avengers: Doomsday.
body_md:
Hailee Steinfeld and her husband Josh Allen welcomed a daughter in spring 2026. The actress is now considering her family experience as she evaluates future roles, while continuing an active career in film and animation.

Personal connections have informed her work before. Preparing to portray Mary in Sinners prompted Steinfeld to explore her family history and develop a deeper understanding of her heritage.

Disney Animation's Hexed arrives at a particularly meaningful moment. Its story centers on a mother and teenage daughter against a magical backdrop. Steinfeld has explained that the perspective of an overprotective mother resonates differently with her now.

Her appearance as Kate Bishop in Avengers: Doomsday was confirmed by the final trailer. The film is scheduled for December 18, 2026. She is also returning as the voice of Gwen Stacy in Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse, scheduled for June 18, 2027.

Her comments suggest an evolving approach to choosing and understanding characters rather than a withdrawal from acting.
